reviews.name: Syed Rehan & Group
reviews.text: Best place to have fun with friends and family. Tasty food and a good environment. The Chicken Mandi platter portion is generous and perfect for group sharing.

reviews.name: Karthik Reddy
reviews.text: The meat is cooked with heat and smoke, creating a flavorful and juicy dish. You can really taste the authenticity in their slow dum process. Worth every rupee!

reviews.name: Mohammed Farhan
reviews.text: Fry piece mandi is so good here. The crisp on the chicken pieces combined with the aromatic basmati rice and tomato salata is unbeatable in this area.

reviews.name: Ananya Sharma
reviews.text: Super pocket-friendly (just ₹200–₹400 per person) for such rich Arabian vibes! We celebrated our friend's birthday here, and the ambience was warm and vibrant.
